title: Pan-Seared Fish Fillet with Herb Crust
description: A simple and flavorful dish featuring a seared fish fillet topped with a fragrant herb crust. This recipe is a great option for a quick dinner or lunch.
instructions: Season the fish fillet with salt and pepper.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced yellow onion to the skillet and cook until translucent.
Add the chopped fresh herbs to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Place the fish fillet in the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
Remove the skillet from the oven and serve the fish fillet hot with the herb crust.
